title: 双岩包之间
description: 分层纸雕表现两只低岩包之间的平衡转换，路径与软垫一目了然。

art_direction.medium: editorial geometric illustration with credible adult proportions
art_direction.scene: An original layered-cardboard illustration depicts a fictional clothed adult moving between two low triangular volumes on a vertical bouldering wall. Each volume carries a visible positive foothold, and broad plum handholds provide balanced support for a short lateral transfer. The climber's near foot bears weight while the other shoe reaches the next foothold without jumping. Show an oblique wide composition with the full figure, both volumes, and an uninterrupted padded floor extending beyond them. Use cut edges, soft stacked shadows, warm gray cardboard, and selective purple paint. Keep adult anatomy believable and the landing empty. Include no writing, logos, high positions, or exaggerated flexibility.
